Video description: On May 18, 2024, a 17-year-old boy celebrated his board results with a night of drinking and speeding in an unregistered Porsche. By 2:30 AM, his reckless driving claimed the lives of two innocent people. What followed was a shocking attempt to cover up the crime.
This case shows how power and privilege often bend the law. But it also reminds us why public pressure is key to justice. Over the next 25 minutes, we’ll uncover the full story—one that shouldn’t be forgotten.
